understanding.goal_understanding: The goal was to progress through every level by moving each selectable piece onto a goal tile marked +, with all goals occupied simultaneously before the level could be completed.
understanding.mechanics_understanding: Pieces moved one grid cell per directional action, while walls could block movement and pushable blocks could be shifted when adjacent. Multiple selectable pieces could be controlled by clicking their pixel-coordinate positions; movement applied only to the currently selected piece. The blocked indicators were hints rather than guarantees, so actions sometimes had to be tested.
